newsitem.title: USA: New England Business expects charge in Q1.
newsitem.headline: New England Business expects charge in Q1.

text.p: New England Business Service Inc said Wednesday that the company will take a pretax charge of about $5.2 million against results for the first quarter ending September 30 and expects an additional pretax expense of $1.3 million during the year.
In a release issued Wednesday, the company said the charges are related to consolidating operations and other cost reduction actions, including job cuts.
However, New England Business said that when fully implemented, the cost cut actions are expected to increase quarterly earnings as much as $0.12 to $0.14 a share.
The company said it reached a decision with Kinko's Corp for a new retail direction initiative which includes consolidation and eliminating some positions.
As part of the action, New England Business said it will incur a total of $0.21 a share in the first quarter in charges.
It added that it expects to incur $0.05 a share during the second quarter and $0.03 a share during the third quarter.

A company executive added in the release that while the Kinko's initiative will be costly at first, "the experience gained and the investments in technology made over the past year will provide a solid foundation for alternative retail growth strategies."
